output.taskText: Can we fix the issue for flickering upon clicking any button across the app?

planSteps.description: Review button click patterns in main.py to identify all `st.rerun()` calls causing flickering (lines: 1029, 1228, 1257, 1447, 1461, 1546, 1632, 1642, 1652, 1670)
Create callback functions in main.py to handle button state changes and store them in `st.session_state` instead of calling `st.rerun()`
Replace the login form submit `st.rerun()` (line 1029) with proper session state management using form submission callback
Remove `st.rerun()` after "Save Address" button (line 1228) and use session state to trigger re-render
Remove `st.rerun()` after "Update Address" button (line 1257) and manage state without explicit rerun
Remove `st.rerun()` after "Accept Order" button (line 1447) and use session state callbacks instead
Remove `st.rerun()` after "Mark as Ready" button (line 1461) and refactor with proper state management
Replace remaining `st.rerun()` calls in driver portal (lines 1546, 1632, 1642, 1652, 1670) with session state-based updates and callback functions
